headlines.summary:

headlines.title_en: CICC wins 16.3 billion yuan in third SFISF operation, completes first pledged repo transactions
headlines.summary_en: The People's Bank of China recently conducted a Securities, Funds and Insurance Companies Swap Facility (SFISF) operation totaling 100 billion yuan, using a rate bidding method. Thirty-one securities and fund companies participated in the bidding, with a winning rate of 10bp. In this operation, CICC won a total of 16.3 billion yuan.

headlines.title: 晶华微：公司及控股股东收到中国证监会立案告知书
headlines.summary: 晶华微公告，公司股票连续2个交易日内（2026年11月3日、2026年11月4日）收盘价格跌幅偏离值累计超过30%，属于股票交易异常波动。经自查，公司近期日常经营情况未发生重大变化，市场环境或行业政策未发生重大调整。公司及控股股东收到中国证监会立案告知书，部分证券账户、银行账户被冻结；截至公告披露日，中国证监会调查尚在进行中。

headlines.title_en: Jinghua Micro: Company and controlling shareholder receive CSRC case filing notice
headlines.summary_en: Jinghua Micro announced that its stock's closing price deviation cumulatively exceeded 30% over two consecutive trading days (November 3 and November 4, 2026), constituting abnormal stock trading fluctuations. Upon self-examination, the company's recent daily operations have not undergone major changes, and the market environment or industry policies have not undergone major adjustments. The company and its controlling shareholder received the CSRC's Notice of Case Filing, and some securities accounts and bank accounts have been frozen; as of the announcement date, the CSRC investigation is still ongoing.

headlines.title_en: Everbright Securities wins third SFISF operation
headlines.summary_en: The People's Bank of China recently conducted its third Securities, Funds and Insurance Companies Swap Facility (SFISF) operation, with a total amount of 100 billion yuan, a winning rate of 10bp, and a swap term of one year, extendable as appropriate. headlines.title: 王毅会见柬埔寨副首相兼外交大臣布拉索昆
headlines.summary: 中共中央政治局委员、外交部长王毅在北京会见来华出席澜湄合作第十一次外长会的柬埔寨副首相兼外交大臣布拉索昆。 王毅说，双方要共同做好下阶段高层交往筹备工作，加强战略沟通，维护共同战略利益。推进“工业发展走廊”和“鱼米走廊”建设，深化基建、农业等领域务实合作。严打电诈不停步，决不让电诈犯罪死灰复燃。推动澜湄合作项目切实落地，不断增进人民福祉。加强在中国-东盟、东亚合作等多边平台协调配合，推动构建更加公正合理的全球治理体系。（外交部网站）

headlines.title_en: Wang Yi Meets with Cambodian Deputy Prime Minister and Foreign Minister Prak Sokhonn
headlines.summary_en: Member of the Political Bureau of the CPC Central Committee and Foreign Minister Wang Yi met in Beijing with Cambodian Deputy Prime Minister and Foreign Minister Prak Sokhonn, who was in China to attend the 11th Lancang-Mekong Cooperation (LMC) Foreign Ministers' Meeting. Wang Yi said the two sides should jointly prepare for the next stage of high-level exchanges, strengthen strategic communication and safeguard common strategic interests. They should advance the building of the "Industrial Development Corridor" and the "Fish and Rice Corridor," and deepen practical cooperation in infrastructure, agriculture and other fields. They should crack down on telecom fraud without letup and never allow such crimes to resurge. They should push for the effective implementation of LMC projects to continuously improve people's wellbeing. They should strengthen coordination and cooperation in multilateral platforms such as China-ASEAN and East Asia cooperation, and promote the building of a more just and reasonable global governance system. (Foreign Ministry website)

headlines.title: 倍轻松：实控人马学军因操纵证券市场被罚没4047.31万元
headlines.summary: 倍轻松：控股股东、实际控制人马学军收到证监会《行政处罚决定书》，因操纵“倍轻松”案被没收违法所得1011.83万元、罚款3035.48万元，合计4047.31万元，其中马学军承担1184.19万元，并被采取5年证券市场禁入措施及5年证券市场禁止交易措施。公司称事项系其个人问题，与公司生产经营无关。

headlines.title_en: Breo: Actual controller Ma Xuejun fined and confiscated 40.4731 million yuan for manipulating the securities market
headlines.summary_en: Breo: Controlling shareholder and actual controller Ma Xuejun received the CSRC's Administrative Penalty Decision. For manipulating the stock of "Breo," illegal gains of 10.1183 million yuan were confiscated and a fine of 30.3548 million yuan was imposed, totaling 40.4731 million yuan, of which Ma Xuejun bears 11.8419 million yuan. He was also subject to a five-year securities market ban and a five-year prohibition on securities market trading. The company said the matter is his personal issue and unrelated to the company's production and operations.

headlines.title: 倍轻松：实控人因操纵证券市场被罚款1184.19万元
headlines.summary: 倍轻松(688793.SH)公告称，公司控股股东、实控人马学军收到证监会《行政处罚决定书》，因其涉嫌操纵证券市场，证监会决定没收违法所得1011.83万元，并处以罚款3035.48万元，合计罚没4047.31万元。其中马学军个人承担罚款1184.19万元。同时，马学军被采取5年证券市场禁入措施及5年证券市场禁止交易措施。同日公告，公司董事长、总经理马学军因个人原因辞去董事、董事长、总经理等全部职务，辞任后不再担任公司任何职务。董事会推举董事刘志华代行董事长、总经理及相关委员会委员职责。

headlines.title_en: Breo: Actual controller fined 11.8419 million yuan for manipulating the securities market
headlines.summary_en: Breo (688793.SH) announced that controlling shareholder and actual controller Ma Xuejun received the CSRC's Administrative Penalty Decision. For suspected manipulation of the securities market, the CSRC decided to confiscate illegal gains of 10.1183 million yuan and impose a fine of 30.3548 million yuan, totaling 40.4731 million yuan in confiscation and fines. Ma Xuejun personally bears 11.8419 million yuan of the fine. He was also subject to a five-year securities market ban and a five-year prohibition on securities market trading. In a same-day announcement, the company said Chairman and General Manager Ma Xuejun resigned from all positions including director, chairman and general manager for personal reasons, and will no longer hold any position in the company after resignation. The board elected director Liu Zhihua to perform the duties of chairman, general manager and member of relevant committees.

headlines.summary: 金十数据11月4日讯，倍轻松公告，公司控股股东、实际控制人马学军收到中国证监会《行政处罚决定书》。此前马学军因涉嫌操纵证券市场被立案调查，2026年6月收到《行政处罚事先告知书》。本次决定书显示，对马学军等7人操纵"倍轻松"行为没收违法所得1011.83万元，并处以3035.48万元罚款，合计4047.31万元，其中马学军承担1184.19万元；对马学军采取5年证券市场禁入措施及5年证券市场禁止交易措施。

headlines.title_en: Breo: Controlling shareholder Ma Xuejun fined 11.8419 million yuan for manipulating the securities market and banned from the market for 5 years
headlines.summary_en: Jinshi Data, November 4: Breo announced that controlling shareholder and actual controller Ma Xuejun received the CSRC's Administrative Penalty Decision. Ma Xuejun had previously been investigated for suspected manipulation of the securities market and received a Prior Notice of Administrative Penalty in June 2026. The decision shows that for the manipulation of "Breo" by Ma Xuejun and six others, illegal gains of 10.1183 million yuan were confiscated and a fine of 30.3548 million yuan was imposed, totaling 40.4731 million yuan, of which Ma Xuejun bears 11.8419 million yuan. Ma Xuejun was subject to a five-year securities market ban and a five-year prohibition on securities market trading.

headlines.title: 招商证券李昊阳：稳市政策助力市场温和回升
headlines.summary: 招商证券首席策略分析师李昊阳表示，近期逆周期稳市举措陆续出台，从跨市场流动性风险阻断、产业资本激励、指数资金入市、交易制度配套四个维度协同发力，政策落地节奏紧凑、工具定位清晰，逐步打破前期的负面反馈螺旋，持续修复投资者风险偏好，为市场平稳运行构建起多层次、可联动的稳定框架。整体来看，配套机制打通了流动性投放、资金使用、资产承接的全链条，将短期流动性托底与资本市场基础制度建设有机结合，让稳市工具从单点发力走向闭环联动，持续巩固政策成效，为A股估值回归合理区间营造稳定的市场环境。（人民财讯）

headlines.title_en: China Merchants Securities' Li Haoyang: Market-stabilizing policies help market recover moderately
headlines.summary_en: Li Haoyang, Chief Strategy Analyst at China Merchants Securities, said that recent countercyclical market-stabilization measures have been introduced one after another, working in concert across four dimensions: blocking cross-market liquidity risks, incentivizing industrial capital, channeling index funds into the market, and supporting trading-system arrangements. The policies have been rolled out at a tight pace with clear tool positioning, gradually breaking the earlier negative feedback loop, continuously repairing investor risk appetite, and building a multi-tiered, interconnected stability framework for smooth market operation. Overall, the supporting mechanisms connect the entire chain of liquidity injection, fund use and asset absorption, organically combining short-term liquidity support with the building of capital market foundational systems, enabling stabilization tools to move from isolated efforts to closed-loop coordination, continuously consolidating policy results, and creating a stable market environment for A-share valuations to return to a reasonable range. (People's Financial News)

This case filing is an investigation of Su Da individually only; the company's businesses and operations are currently normal, and it will not have a major impact on the operation of the company's board of directors or the company's daily operations.

headlines.title: 王毅：澜湄合作已成为区域合作“金色样板”
headlines.summary: 中共中央政治局委员、外交部长王毅在北京主持澜沧江－湄公河合作第十一次外长会。王毅说，澜湄六国同饮一江水，命运紧相连。今年是澜湄合作首次领导人会议召开十周年。十年来，在六国领导人战略引领下，澜湄合作从搭框架、拓领域的建设期迈向强机制、重实效的深耕期，成为最具活力和潜力的区域合作“金色样板”。（央视）

headlines.title_en: Wang Yi: Lancang-Mekong Cooperation has become a 'golden model' of regional cooperation
headlines.summary_en: Member of the Political Bureau of the CPC Central Committee and Foreign Minister Wang Yi chaired the 11th Lancang-Mekong Cooperation Foreign Ministers' Meeting in Beijing. Wang Yi said the six LMC countries share the same river and are closely bound by a shared future. This year marks the 10th anniversary of the first LMC Leaders' Meeting. Over the past decade, under the strategic guidance of the six countries' leaders, LMC has moved from a building phase of setting up frameworks and expanding areas to a deepening phase of strengthening mechanisms and focusing on practical results, becoming the most dynamic and promising "golden model" of regional cooperation. (CCTV)

headlines.title: 王毅谈澜湄合作第十一次外长会成果
headlines.summary: 澜沧江－湄公河合作第十一次外长会在北京举行。会后，中共中央政治局委员、外交部长王毅同共同主席国泰国副总理兼外长西哈萨共同会见记者。 六国外长一致同意，澜湄合作由十年前的一粒种子，已成长为如今的参天大树，得益于六国坚持睦邻友好、命运与共的初心，坚持聚焦发展、务实合作的方向，坚持利民惠民、开放包容的理念，坚持创新驱动、先行先试的勇气。面对当前国际地区多重挑战，澜湄大家庭要以着眼开好澜湄合作第五次领导人会议为契机，推动澜湄合作继续迈上新台阶。

headlines.title_en: Wang Yi discusses outcomes of the 11th Lancang-Mekong Cooperation Foreign Ministers' Meeting
headlines.summary_en: The 11th Lancang-Mekong Cooperation Foreign Ministers' Meeting was held in Beijing. After the meeting, Member of the Political Bureau of the CPC Central Committee and Foreign Minister Wang Yi and Thai Deputy Prime Minister and Foreign Minister Sihasak Phuangketkeow, co-chair of the meeting, jointly met with the press. The six foreign ministers agreed that LMC, from a seed ten years ago, has grown into a towering tree today, thanks to the six countries' commitment to good-neighborliness and a shared future, to focusing on development and practical cooperation, to the philosophy of benefiting the people and openness and inclusiveness, and to the courage of innovation-driven and pioneering exploration. In the face of multiple current international and regional challenges, the LMC family should take the opportunity of convening the fifth LMC Leaders' Meeting to push LMC cooperation to a new level.

headlines.title_en: Wang Wentao delivers video remarks at the 2026 Guangdong-Hong Kong-Macao Greater Bay Area Global Investment Promotion Conference
headlines.summary_en: On November 3, the 2026 Guangdong-Hong Kong-Macao Greater Bay Area Global Investment Promotion Conference, jointly hosted by the governments of Guangdong, Hong Kong and Macao, was held in Guangzhou. headlines.summary_en: On the sidelines of the 11th Lancang-Mekong Cooperation Foreign Ministers' Meeting, Member of the Political Bureau of the CPC Central Committee and Foreign Minister Wang Yi invited Cambodian Deputy Prime Minister and Foreign Minister Prak Sokhonn and Thai Deputy Prime Minister and Foreign Minister Sihasak Phuangketkeow for a tea conversation. headlines.title: 亨通光电：控股股东亨通集团拟增持不低于4亿元且不超过6亿元
headlines.summary: 亨通光电公告，控股股东亨通集团有限公司计划自公告披露之日起12个月内，通过上海证券交易所系统以集中竞价方式增持公司A股，拟增持金额不低于人民币4亿元（含）且不超过人民币6亿元（含），资金来源为自有资金和/或自筹资金，增持数量及比例以实际交易情况为准。增持计划实施期间，亨通集团承诺不减持所持公司股份；如公司股票因筹划重大事项连续停牌10个交易日以上，计划在股票复牌后顺延实施。该计划不会导致公司控股股东及实际控制人发生变化。

headlines.title_en: Hengtong Optic-Electric: Controlling shareholder Hengtong Group plans to increase its stake by no less than RMB 400 million and no more than RMB 600 million
headlines.summary_en: Hengtong Optic-Electric announced that controlling shareholder Hengtong Group Co., Ltd. plans to increase its holdings of the company's A-shares through centralized competitive bidding via the Shanghai Stock Exchange system within 12 months from the date of the announcement, with a planned increase of no less than 400 million yuan (inclusive) and no more than 600 million yuan (inclusive). The source of funds is its own funds and/or self-raised funds, and the number and proportion of shares increased shall be subject to actual transactions. During the implementation of the increase plan, Hengtong Group promises not to reduce its holdings of the company's shares; if the company's stock is suspended for more than 10 consecutive trading days due to planning major matters, the plan will be extended after trading resumes. The plan will not cause a change in the company's controlling shareholder or actual controller.

headlines.title: 海光信息：拟5亿元-8亿元回购公司股份
headlines.summary: 海光信息公告，经审议，董事会同意公司将以自有资金和/或自筹资金通过上海证券交易所交易系统以集中竞价交易方式回购公司已发行的部分人民币普通股（A股）股票，在未来适宜时机用于员工持股计划或股权激励。回购价格不超过318.52元/股（含），回购资金总额不低于人民币50,000.00万元（含），不超过人民币80,000.00万元（含）；同时授权公司管理层全权办理本次回购股份的相关事宜。根据《公司章程》的有关规定，本次回购股份方案无需提交公司股东会审议。

headlines.title_en: Hygon Information: Plans share buyback of RMB 500 million to RMB 800 million
headlines.summary_en: Hygon Information announced that, upon deliberation, the board agreed that the company will use its own funds and/or self-raised funds to repurchase part of its issued RMB ordinary shares (A-shares) through the centralized bidding trading method via the Shanghai Stock Exchange trading system, to be used for employee stock ownership plans or equity incentives at an appropriate time in the future. The repurchase price shall not exceed RMB 318.52 per share (inclusive), and the total repurchase amount shall be no less than RMB 500.00 million (inclusive) and no more than RMB 800.00 million (inclusive); meanwhile, the company's management is authorized to handle all matters related to this share repurchase. According to the relevant provisions of the Articles of Association, this share repurchase plan does not need to be submitted to the company's shareholders' meeting for deliberation.

headlines.title: 广钢气体：董事长邓韬提议以2亿元-4亿元回购公司股份
headlines.summary: 广钢气体公告，董事长邓韬提议公司使用自有资金或自筹资金，通过集中竞价交易方式回购公司A股，回购资金总额不低于人民币2亿元（含）、不超过人民币4亿元（含），回购价格不超过董事会审议通过回购方案决议前30个交易日公司股票交易均价的150%。回购股份拟在未来适宜时机用于股权激励、员工持股计划等；若股份回购实施结果暨股份变动公告日后3年内未使用完毕，尚未使用的股份将予以注销。回购期限为董事会审议通过方案之日起12个月。该提议尚需履行相关审批程序，最终方案以公司审议通过的方案为准。

headlines.title_en: Guanggang Gas: Chairman Deng Tao proposes share buyback of RMB 200 million to RMB 400 million
headlines.summary_en: Guanggang Gas announced that Chairman Deng Tao proposed that the company use its own funds or self-raised funds to repurchase its A-shares through centralized competitive bidding, with a total repurchase amount of no less than 200 million yuan (inclusive) and no more than 400 million yuan (inclusive), and a repurchase price not exceeding 150% of the average trading price of the company's stock over the 30 trading days before the board resolution approving the repurchase plan. The repurchased shares are intended to be used for equity incentives, employee stock ownership plans, etc. at an appropriate time in the future; if not used up within three years after the announcement of the repurchase implementation results and share changes, the unused shares will be cancelled. The repurchase period is 12 months from the date the board approves the plan. The proposal is still subject to relevant approval procedures, and the final plan shall be subject to the plan approved by the company.
